issues.description: findChangedFiles can return null/undefined and silently disables filtering
issues.detail: onTestRunStart sets changedFiles to undefined when VitestGit returns null (e.g., not a git repo, bad ref). The code then falls through to report coverage for ALL files instead of failing loudly. A user who asked for changed-only coverage and got full coverage will not notice until production. Warn or throw.

issues.description: changedFiles comparison uses plain string equality on paths without normalization
issues.detail: isIncluded compares slash(cleanUrl(filename)) against this.changedFiles.includes(filename), but findChangedFiles returns whatever git produced. If one side is absolute and the other relative, or slashes differ on Windows, every file mismatches and coverage silently goes empty. Show me a test that runs on Windows with mixed separators.

issues.description: globCache is shared but only cleared in onTestRunStart, not when changedFiles is unset
issues.detail: If isIncluded runs before onTestRunStart (resolveGlobPatterns path, or any provider that pre-warms), entries get cached without the changedFiles filter applied, then survive the later clear sequence depending on ordering. The cache key is just the filename — it doesn't encode the filter state. Either key on (filename, hasChangedFilter) or audit every call site.

issues.description: onTestRunStart hook added to three call sites by hand instead of wrapping start()
issues.detail: core.ts now has three identical `await this.coverageProvider?.onTestRunStart?.()` lines after `_testRun.start(...)`. The fourth code path that gets added next year will forget it. Either fold this into _testRun.start or into a helper. Bad taste is repeating the same special case three times.

issues.description: CLI transform accepts boolean inputs that the CLI parser never produces
issues.detail: The transform checks `value === true` and `value === false`, but CLI args arrive as strings. Dead branches. Either document why (shared with programmatic config?) or delete the bool checks. Code that handles cases it doesn't see invites bugs when someone later relies on the wrong branch.

issues.description: Test file mode flipped from 644 to 755 for no reason
issues.detail: test/coverage-test/test/changed.test.ts goes from old mode 100644 to new mode 100755. A .ts test file is not executable. This is the kind of accidental chmod that clutters diffs and makes maintainers wonder if something is going on. Revert the mode bit.

review.summary: The feature is a sensible scope and the diff is mostly readable, but the file-path matching layer is fragile: changedFiles comparison happens by exact string equality after slash+cleanUrl on one side and raw git output on the other, with no normalization or Windows test. The globCache is keyed only on filename and clearing it inside onTestRunStart assumes a strict ordering that the three hand-pasted call sites in core.ts don't enforce. Silent fallthrough when VitestGit returns null turns "no changes detected" into "report everything," which is the opposite of what the user asked for. NEEDS-WORK: tighten path normalization, fail loud when changedFiles cannot be resolved, fold the onTestRunStart call into the start path, and drop the accidental chmod +x on the test file.
